name: Elentix Addons for Elementor
author: RSTheme

sections.description:
Elentix Addons for Elementor extends the Elementor page builder by adding a set of modern, performance-optimized widgets and useful extensions.

The plugin is built with clean architecture, strict compatibility checks, and modular asset loading to ensure it works smoothly with Elementor without unnecessary bloat.

🚀 Free Widgets Included

  • Heading
  • Button
  • Icon Box
  • Icon List
  • Social Icons
  • Progress Bar
  • Testimonial
  • Team Members
  • Logo Showcase
  • Video Popup
  • Blog Post Grid
  • Counter

Each widget loads only the required CSS and JavaScript to keep your site fast.

🔧 Free Extensions

  • Custom CSS – Add custom CSS directly to supported elements
  • Link Anything – Make any element clickable
  • AOS Animations – Animate elements on scroll using AOS

🧩 Smart Asset Management

  • Uses Swiper for sliders
  • Uses AOS for scroll animations
  • Uses Odometer for Counter
  • Assets are registered and loaded only when required

⚙️ Built With Developers in Mind

  • Namespaced codebase
  • Elementor version & PHP version checks
  • Modular widget & extension system
  • Clean activation and version handling

⚠️ This plugin requires Elementor to be installed and activated.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.6 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later
  • Elementor 3.30 or later

If requirements are not met, the plugin will display admin notices and safely disable itself.

Credits

  • Elementor – Page Builder
  • Swiper.js
  • AOS (Animate On Scroll)
  • Odometer
  • Appear

Author

Developed by RSTheme
Website: https://rstheme.com/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the elentix-addons-for-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated
  4. Open Elementor Editor and start using Elentix Addons widgets
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without Elementor?

No. Elementor must be installed and activated.

Will it slow down my website?

No. Widgets and extensions load assets only when needed.

Is this plugin free?

Yes. This version includes free widgets and extensions. Pro features may be added later.

Can I disable unused widgets or extensions?

Yes. The plugin is built to support enabling/disabling widgets and extensions internally.
